devdoc.details: Manages compliance rules for ERC-3643 token transfers

addTokenHolder(address).details: Updates token holder count when tokens are added to an account

addTrustedContract(address).details: Adds a trusted contract that can call restricted functions

canTransfer(address,address,uint256).details: Checks if a transfer is compliant

returns._0: True if the transfer is compliant

getMaxTokenHolders().details: Gets the maximum number of token holders

isCountryBlocked(uint16).details: Checks if a country is blocked

returns._0: True if the country is blocked

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeTokenHolder(address).details: Updates token holder count when tokens are removed from an account

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setMaxTokenHolders(uint256).details: Sets the maximum number of token holders

tokenHolderCount().details: Gets the current number of token holders

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: Compliance
